suites.title: T-02 voice tooling and the voice lint (no browser)

specs.title: hashes: a fixed input gives a fixed hash; words, voice, locale, rate and pronunciation change the request, encoding changes only the file
hashes: a line re-renders when the manifest field it quotes changes, and for nothing else
SSML: text escapes & < >, attributes escape all five; every plain character maps back from its SSML position
word events: the SDK-shaped fixture converts to the documented timing file
timing file checks: order, ranges, audio length and coverage
spoken lines: node lines, Ask lines and answers; @ lines once per door; runtime tokens captions-only; the summary is not spoken
dry run: marks exactly the line whose words changed, a settings change, a missing file and an orphan
dry run: over budget exits 2 and names the limit
dry run on content/tour.json needs no key and prints billable characters and the cost
--check without credentials names each missing variable and exits non-zero, printing no value
credentials: the environment first, then ~/.env, only the two names read, values never printed
MP3 header parser reads the ffmpeg-made fixture, with or without an ID3 tag
ffmpeg pipeline: loudness to target, speech start kept to the millisecond, mono 24 kHz 48 kbps
render: a stand-in synthesiser renders a small script that the lint passes; re-runs render only what changed

steps.title: first render: every line, through the service
a re-run renders nothing and rewrites nothing
one edited line re-renders alone; the lint calls the old file stale until then
an encoding change re-encodes from the cache with no request; orphans are pruned
the lint refuses broken files whatever guide.voice.required says

specs.title: lint: missing audio is a warning while guide.voice.required is false and an error once it is true
service calls: throttling and transient errors retry with backoff, others fail at once; requests are paced

hashes: a fixed input gives a fixed hash; words, voice, locale, rate and pronunciation change the request, encoding changes only the file
hashes: a line re-renders when the manifest field it quotes changes, and for nothing else
SSML: text escapes & < >, attributes escape all five; every plain character maps back from its SSML position
word events: the SDK-shaped fixture converts to the documented timing file
timing file checks: order, ranges, audio length and coverage
spoken lines: node lines, Ask lines and answers; @ lines once per door; runtime tokens captions-only; the summary is not spoken
dry run: marks exactly the line whose words changed, a settings change, a missing file and an orphan
dry run: over budget exits 2 and names the limit
dry run on content/tour.json needs no key and prints billable characters and the cost
--check without credentials names each missing variable and exits non-zero, printing no value
credentials: the environment first, then ~/.env, only the two names read, values never printed
MP3 header parser reads the ffmpeg-made fixture, with or without an ID3 tag
ffmpeg pipeline: loudness to target, speech start kept to the millisecond, mono 24 kHz 48 kbps
render: a stand-in synthesiser renders a small script that the lint passes; re-runs render only what changed

steps.title: first render: every line, through the service
a re-run renders nothing and rewrites nothing
one edited line re-renders alone; the lint calls the old file stale until then
an encoding change re-encodes from the cache with no request; orphans are pruned
the lint refuses broken files whatever guide.voice.required says
